# std/dot

> Field access through a struct pointer: p.field

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/dot.pkg) · translated by [bintables/dot](../bintables/dot.md)

```
let p = new Point
p.x = 3
print p.x + p.y
```

The left side must be a `ptr` to a struct. Fields can be read and
assigned. Accessing a field through `null` crashes the program.

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative; flags `place`

```
{obj: expr ptr ?} . {f: field of obj} -> {f}
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `obj` | expression | `ptr ?` |
| `f` |  | — |

Produces: the type of `f`
